_about: How names and recurring terms are written in this language. Every translation follows this file, so a name is always spelled the same way. Names are written by sound, never translated (the author's rule). The spellings here are first versions based on the written names: the author's own pronunciation is recorded in Legacy/Behind The Scenes/World Lore/Word Pronunciation/Unique Words Pronounciation.wav, so correct any spelling here and later translations will follow it. Add new names the first time they are translated.
rule: Story names in Arabic letters, by sound (ف for v, غ for hard g).
